name: Finite pre-discovery source exposure manifest for prospective novelty bank7
scope: Finite checked local campaign corpus only. Exact PMID disjointness is limited to the listed local artifacts; it is not universal freshness, literature novelty, scientific quality, or retrieval performance.

method.base: Inherited v6 exposure roots, excluding documented synthetic harness placeholders; plus every ID from the full v6 candidate pool (selected and unselected); plus actual study5 retained run-trace/cache PMIDs.
method.study5_cache_note: The retained cache manifest stores paths and hashes, not payload bytes; 72 PMID metadata/no-link IDs were recovered from cache filenames and 73 PubMed IDs from run-result traces, with all 72 contained in those 73. Twenty-four fulltext keys are PMCIDs, kept separately.

exposure_inputs.name: Inherited v6 finite exposure manifest
exposure_inputs.coverage: Prior source proposals/discoveries in the referenced external tree plus study3/study4 archives, as detailed in the inherited manifest.

exposure_inputs.name: Full v6 broad discovery pool, including unselected candidates
Study5 retained private cache manifest PMID keys

limitations: Studies1–4 are represented through the exact finite roots in the inherited v6 manifest; files outside those roots are not certified.
Study5 cache payloads are unavailable in the retained archive; cache PMID keys and run-result traces are included.
No universal source-freshness or literature-novelty claim.
